headline: RBI to hold ₹50,000 crore 2-day VRR auction under LAF on November 23, 2026
summary_points: RBI will conduct a second Variable Rate Repo (VRR) auction under LAF on Monday, November 23, 2026.
The decision follows a review of current and evolving near-term liquidity conditions.
Operational guidelines remain the same as in Press Release 2021-2022/1572 dated January 20, 2022.

rows: As per Press Release 2021-2022/1572 dated January 20, 2022

who_is_affected: Banks and other LAF-eligible participants, along with treasury teams tracking short-term liquidity and money market rates.
action_required: Eligible participants wishing to bid should submit bids within the 10:30 AM to 11:00 AM window on November 23, 2026, following the existing operational guidelines.

social.linkedin:
RBI has announced a second Variable Rate Repo (VRR) auction under the Liquidity Adjustment Facility (LAF).

Key details:
- Date: Monday, November 23, 2026
- Notified amount: ₹50,000 crore
- Tenor: 2 days
- Window: 10:30 AM to 11:00 AM
- Reversal: Wednesday, November 25, 2026

The decision follows a review of current and evolving near-term liquidity conditions. Operational guidelines remain the same as in Press Release 2021-2022/1572 dated January 20, 2022.

For treasury teams, banks and finance professionals, such operations are a useful signal of how the central bank is managing short-term liquidity.

Please verify the details with the official RBI press release (2026-2027/1541) before acting on them.
